notes.title: Devlog #7: The Drone That Will Save Your Life
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome![/h1]

[h3]Another devlog, more news! A new companion in Tarvos – a drone that fights by your side![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/f76f3e5786742f62cb20f666b5551c7cc71c28b3.gif[/img]

Our drone has just received its final texture version. It’s not a shiny gadget fresh from the factory – its surface shows signs of wear, as if it remembers abandoned laboratories and the weight of Tarvos’s industrial world. Thanks to this, it will not only blend into the dark atmosphere but also become a believable part of the environment. It’s equipment that players will encounter in the full version of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/82b8d6b3250a3527e79285d42f7ac7868f2c89ea.png[/img]

[h1]The Drone as the Player’s Companion[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/75b44b8cb1b1605db6687197cc82aa297af1844d.jpg[/img]

But the drone’s usefulness doesn’t end with blending into the dark setting – from the very beginning, we planned for it to become an active companion. Hovering by the player, it will:

[list]
[*] Lock onto enemies: instantly identifies threats and warns the player.
[*] Provide fire support: opens fire, distracting opponents and giving you a moment to counterattack.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/609c554c1e930b4044f6be546323ad296c04868c.gif[/img]

Imagine exploring ruined corridors as the drone quietly flashes its sensors, fires precise shots, and lets the player focus on survival and tactics – the drone becomes an ally and… a living part of the world.

[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]

The next step is to adjust the AI to dynamic combat situations and test how the drone reacts to the chaos of battle – whether it truly helps or still needs fine-tuning so it doesn’t distract the player.

[h1]Thanks for being with us![/h1]

We hope this quick insight into our work on the drone brought you a little closer to our daily life as developers and the atmosphere we’re aiming for. What do you think about the drone as a companion? What extra feature would you give it? Share your ideas in the comments and don’t forget to add Tarvos Desolation to your wishlist if you haven’t already – it’s the best way to help us keep growing the game!

notes.title: Devlog #6: Safe House
notes.content:
Hi! In today’s devlog, we’ll take a look at the new feature we’ve introduced to the world of Tarvos: Desolation.

[h3][b]Safe House:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/f19229c0a172d361f78ffd807934cffc6749efec.gif[/img]

[b]What can you do in the Safe House?[/b]
[list]
[*] Inventory management: Here players can organize their gear, prepare mission loadouts, upgrade weapons and armor.
[*] The place allows you to rest and regenerate health.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/404897b93027d50480cbf5e0642de3a700be9e5b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/6df8557a468d1038e396f618635c9fc7c75105ac.jpg[/img]
The Safe House will be a location players can access after completing a given mission. Its appearance will change depending on the game progress.

In the previous devlog, we presented models representing health, shield, and oxygen, which can be found during the journey on Tarvos.

[h3][b]The player will need to pay attention to 3 parameters:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Armor – The durability of the suit, which can be upgraded over time. If the armor is at a good level, it prevents the decrease of vital stats.
[*] Health – Decreases when the armor is broken; losing health equals death and loss of level progress.
[*] Oxygen – The oxygen level affects the reduction of health, regardless of how strong the armor is. Lack of oxygen negates everything.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/17402a7b79f1bc8559080a9606bdd28983b3ecc3.png[/img]

[h3]That’s all for today![/h3]

notes.title: Devlog #4 – Suggest a name for new boss
notes.content:
Hi there!

We know it’s been a while since our last update — we disappeared off the radar for a bit, but not without reason. Over the past few months, we’ve been hard at work on Tarvos Desolation, and today we’re finally ready to share the results of that work with you.

This time around, there’s less narrative, but more solid information. We’ve prepared a breakdown of the newest features, models, and improvements we’re working on for upcoming versions of the game. If you’re waiting for fresh news about monsters, gear, and mechanics – this post is for you.

[h1]New Monster:[/h1]

We're planning a new boss – a mutated version of one of the existing creatures. It's still early in development and we're gathering ideas, but we already know it'll be a tough opponent with unique attacks and a dark backstory. We're also thinking about a name – if you have any ideas, feel free to share them on our Discord or any of the social platforms where we're active!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/20e4d3ca98c94bb13e449c30a1538a81fcbece76.png[/img]

[h1]Grenade Launcher:[/h1]

As part of our ongoing weapon system work, we’ve added a new grenade launcher model to the arsenal. It’s still an early version, but we wanted to share the current look — compact, straightforward, and built for functionality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/66a47b342ab41df9af72aa32c02858f6dfd6f7e5.png[/img]

[h3]Key features:[/h3]

[i]Compact build:[/i] The model appears solid but not excessively heavy — ideal for close-quarters combat and tight spaces.

[i]Top detail:[/i] The top part includes a sight or mounting system — small, but enough to give the weapon a tactical look.

[i]Clear segmentation:[/i] Three main components stand out: the body, barrel, and rear section. Each has been sculpted separately using different shades of gray, making it easier for players to read its shape during fast-paced gameplay.

[i]Neutral color scheme:[/i] The muted tones (graphite, gray, black) suggest a military purpose and fit well with the rest of our gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/1000562627e74a15b07a8f9fcf5d22df591a9774.png[/img]

[h3]Function in-game:[/h3]

We’re not revealing full combat details just yet — but this will be a high-impact weapon, designed to deal with groups of enemies and environmental cover. It’ll shine in scenarios where raw firepower matters more than precision.

[h1]Exoskeleton:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/ad237aa283c1f5a026b911ac8a2e67a18141be2d.png[/img]

[h3]Key features:[/h3]

[i]Modular design:[/i] Each component of the exoskeleton has been designed to allow for mission-specific customization.

[i]Reinforced limbs:[/i] Thick joints and mechanical support systems provide extra strength and durability. This suit is useful in both close combat and heavy lifting scenarios.

[i]Tactical details:[/i] Various mounts are visible on the torso, allowing for integration of targeting systems, shields, or extra gear.

[i]Neutral, military color palette:[/i] Dark tones dominate — graphite, gray, matte black. The exoskeleton blends in with other equipment and doesn’t stand out in combat zones.

[h1]Weapon Handling:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/10f8a55028167f84fb5cc893bf822ae1d7a240c8.png[/img]

We aimed to enhance immersion through subtle but crucial changes to how the character interacts with weapons. We believe that weapon handling affects not only visual appeal but also how the combat mechanics feel — players should feel the difference between a heavy grenade launcher and a rapid-firing laser rifle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/b55ca67ba79fed3e78db9113b2513ab8196a3400.png[/img]

[h1]Join the Community![/h1]

Your feedback is incredibly important to us. Follow our journey on social media and join the conversation on our Discord server — connect with other players, share your thoughts, and get exclusive updates.

[i]Until the next update.

— Tarvos Research Team[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #3 - New Monster, Velpendra, Perks System
notes.content:
[b]Date:[/b] 7th Cycle, Moon Tarvos
May 4, 2120 – Earth

Location: First expedition station on Tarvos

[i]We encountered her in the dark stone trenches just after landing on the moon. Velpendra – a predator with an elongated, segmented body and numerous limbs ending in blades. She moves quickly, silently, always from the side, never head-on.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/27c33ddbdc105d8aede271b1f142a9f6008be3d0.png[/img]

*[i]She strikes with lightning speed and precision, targeting critical points. We examined the site of the attack – she leaves behind nothing but thin marks in the ground and streaks of blood. Her exoskeleton is as hard as ceramic fibers, nearly impervious to small-caliber firearms.

You won’t notice them until it’s too late.
The creature hunts in packs.

Velpendra – classification: predatory organism, subterranean arthropod.
Exercise extreme caution.*[/i]

Sergeant Lina Vorsk

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/1e553a2ac39e518f6e14e43f3b71b5c76a57e052.png[/img]

[b][h2]News:[/h2][/b]

Hey there! We’re constantly working on the development of our game.

We’ve kicked off internal beta testing to eliminate as many bugs as possible before the release of the demo – which will soon see the light of day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/ab1f3d260a80cfe5d69331f6a0cc3736946c2211.png[/img]

Currently, we're focusing on optimization and polishing the perk system and difficulty balance.
Each level within a Chapter will have individual difficulty settings that will affect, among other things, the number of enemies, experience gained, and the quality and quantity of loot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/d9e10ad232a6e09b3f19644ad72ee7a8a76782ff.png[/img]

Thanks to this, even after completing the story mode on the lowest difficulty, players will be able to return to the game to face new challenges and experience the true hell of Tarvos – once again. More enemies, tougher challenges, better rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/946d0bed96d2d477b38be63a84cd74956530372b.png[/img]

Join our Discord and follow us on social media to stay up to date with all the latest news and announcements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/4d07a4ef3b39b6f5644d586ccbc55e7f0840ec9f.gif[/img]

*[i]Until the next entry.

— Tarvos Research Team*[/i]

notes.title: Journal de développement #2 – Nouveau monstre, Morphulon
notes.content:
[h3]Field Journal: Entry 2178-A

Date: 12th cycle, Moon of Tarvos
January 27, 2145 on Earth

Location: Dry Lakes of Tarvos[/h3]

[i]I can't believe what I just witnessed—this is my first true discovery and it exceeds all my expectations. While exploring the dry lakes of Tarvos, my team encountered a creature that I can only describe as a "Morphulon." We used everything against it: plasma, projectiles, but it was remarkably resistant to everything.

Then it happened. One of my companions was captured. The creature wrapped its spiked tendrils around him, and within seconds he was gone. It devoured him, absorbed his body, and then the creature fully regenerated. It was as if it fed to heal itself—a terrifying display of its power, a different level of mutation.

I can't let this discovery be forgotten. I named this creature "Morphulon." This is my discovery and it will change everything. A creature that feeds to heal itself... it's an incredible find.

Dr. Marek Kotar, Chief of Research Base, Tarvos[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/1574738f5f4b64ab90d41861a747bd0be55453af.gif[/img]

[h2]Exhibit: MUT-07X[/h2]

[i][h3]"Morphulon"[/h3][/i]

[b]Description:[/b] Organically evolved predator with eight hyper-elastic appendages covered in tissue-like spines. (Some more mutated species may have 12 or even 14 appendages). The central body pulses with visible nodes of the circulatory system, suggesting high metabolic activity.

[b]Mutation Index:[/b] 2.7 (rapid limb regeneration after feeding).

[b]Behavior:[/b]Primarily ambush; tentacles serve both for grasping and digesting, secreting paralyzing enzymes before feeding begins. Victims are externally dissolved and absorbed through epidermal osmosis.

[b]Habitat:[/b] Found over the dry lakes on the Moon of Tarvos. Uses semi-translucent skin to blend into the surroundings.

[i]I wasn't able to take a picture; people were injured and we focused on getting back to base. However, after we were safe, I managed to sketch the Morphulon. I hope I captured its appearance correctly. I processed the sketches in our visualization software, and everything is now archived at the base.
I wonder how much more we can discover...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/814a7e0404bb06ac47cde5e109881a3bd9da6f11.gif[/img]

Until the next entry.

— Tarvos Research Team

notes.title: Devlog #1 - New Title and More Changes
notes.content:
[h1][b]Greetings, Survivors![/b][/h1]

We’re excited to share some changes with you! Today marks a significant step in the evolution of our project that has now transformed into something darker and even more fitting for the unsettling journey we’re creating. Welcome to Tarvos Desolation — a name that better captures a sci-fi horror that awaits you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/7fb200eb429c99b0bea98a49c3dc564b73b029fe.png[/img]

[h2][b]Why the Name Change?[/b][/h2]

The decision to rebrand our game wasn’t made lightly. As development progressed and the world of Jupiter Survivor took shape, we realized the name didn’t fully encapsulate the isolation and dread we wanted players to feel. We chose Tarvos over Jupiter because it’s not explored in other games, allowing us to create something unique. Its small size and landscape create a claustrophobic atmosphere that adds tension and fits the emotional depth we want in our story. While "Desolation" underscores the loneliness and danger that define the experience.

[h2][b]Our Efforts Behind the Scenes[/b][/h2]

Renaming the game was just one part of the journey. Every corner of Tarvos Desolation is being meticulously crafted to immerse you in its terrifying atmosphere. We’ve removed or redesigned some monsters to better fit the game’s tone, making every encounter more impactful and memorable for players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/243042095335229b275b025ead54ac46fa18f621.png[/img]

We’ve worked hard to make combat more intense. Surviving means choosing your battles wisely and staying sharp against relentless enemies. Every fight on Tarvos is a test of your skills and determination.

[h2][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h2]

Moving forward, our focus will remain on delivering the same intense, horror-filled experience we’ve always envisioned. The name may have changed, but the soul of the game hasn’t. You’ll still face:

[list]
[*] Relentless hordes of monsters that adapt and challenge your strategies.
[*] Exploration of mysterious locations steeped in danger and lore.
[*] A gripping mystery waiting to be uncovered in the depths of an abandoned moon
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057663/88d878d93573afdf373ca2ffc18e8eabdfc7651b.gif[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates as we bring Tarvos Desolation closer to completion.

[h2][b]Join the Conversation[/b][/h2]

Your feedback and support mean everything to us. By sharing your ideas, insights, and enthusiasm, you’re helping shape the very core of Tarvos Desolation. Be sure to follow our journey on social media and join the conversation on our Discord server, where you can connect with fellow players, share your thoughts, and get exclusive updates on development progress and discover our other projects..
